preconditions.description: The length of the input string is between 1 and 10^5 characters.

preconditions.expression: input_string consists of small Latin letters
preconditions.description: The input string contains only small Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output contains an integer k, which is the number of nonempty parts of the password.
The following k lines each contain two integers xi and li, representing the start position and length of a part of the password.
The starting position xi of each part is between 1 and the length of the input string.
The length li of each part is positive.
The middle part of the password has an odd length.
The goal is to maximize the sum of the lengths li of all parts of the password.
